description: Build an UNSIGNED buy or sell transaction (base64, legacy format) for the given wallet. This does not execute the trade or move funds. To execute it, sign with that wallet and broadcast to Solana before lastValidBlockHeight. Never send a private key to this tool or any other.

amount.description: Positive integer as a string. buy: SOL in lamports (1 SOL = 1000000000). sell: raw token units (6 decimals, 1 token = 1000000)

priorityFeeMicroLamports.description: Priority fee per compute unit, in micro-lamports. Default 10000. Raise it if trades aren't landing when Solana is busy; the maximum adds at most 0.00025 SOL

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points, up to 500 (5%). Default 100 (1%). A sandwich bot can take up to the whole tolerance, so keep it tight

walletPublicKey.description: Public address of the wallet that will sign and pay (base58)

name: prepare_trade
